patho.caption_source: The linear abnormality, namely pencil-like hyperintensity, was also observed on DWI (b). The hyperintensities became a pair of apparent hyperintense lesions on DWI (d) and corresponded to owl’s eyes sign. She was diagnosed with spinal cord infarction.
